Gold Purity Guide

24K, 22K, 21K & 18K Gold

Gold karat indicates the proportion of pure gold in an item. Understanding purity helps customers compare gold prices correctly when reviewing jewellery in Sargodha.

99.9% Pure

24 Karat

24K represents very high-purity gold and is commonly used as the reference point when discussing fine-gold market values.

91.6% Pure

22 Karat

22K contains approximately 91.6% gold and is widely used in traditional jewellery because it combines high gold content with useful durability.

87.5% Pure

21 Karat

21K contains approximately 87.5% gold. It is an important jewellery purity in Pakistan and is often included when customers compare local gold rates.

75% Pure

18 Karat

18K contains 75% gold and a larger proportion of other metals. It can provide additional strength and flexibility for certain jewellery designs.

✦ Always confirm the stated purity and weight before purchase. ✦

Market Factors

What Affects the Gold Rate?

International Gold Prices

Gold is traded internationally, so global market movements can influence local prices.

USD / PKR Exchange Rate

Because international gold prices are generally expressed in US dollars, currency movements can affect the local Pakistani value.

Local Market Conditions

Local supply, demand, market activity and trading conditions can affect the rate available in Sargodha.

Purity and Weight

The final gold value depends on both the item's purity and its actual weight.

Buyer Guide

How to Compare Gold Prices

1. Check the Karat

Confirm whether the jewellery is 24K, 22K, 21K or 18K before comparing prices.

2. Confirm the Weight

Ask whether the quoted amount applies to one gram, ten grams or one tola.

3. Understand Jewellery Charges

The market value of the gold and the final price of finished jewellery are not always identical because workmanship and design can affect the final amount.

4. Confirm the Current Quote

Contact the jeweller before completing the transaction because market prices can change.

Common Questions

Gold Rate FAQs

What is the gold rate in Sargodha?

The gold rate in Sargodha changes according to international gold prices, currency movements and local market conditions. The values shown on this page are reference figures. Contact SM Gold for the latest available transaction rate.

What is the gold rate in Sargodha today for 24K?

24K is the highest commonly referenced gold purity. Its market value changes with current conditions. Please contact SM Gold for the current 24K quote.

What is the 21K gold rate per tola in Sargodha?

21K gold contains approximately 87.5% gold. Its per-tola value depends on the current gold benchmark and local market conditions. Contact SM Gold for the latest applicable figure.

Why is gold price different for each karat?

Each karat contains a different percentage of pure gold. Therefore, 24K, 22K, 21K and 18K values are calculated differently.

Is the displayed gold price the final jewellery price?

No. The displayed figures are reference market values. A finished jewellery item's final price can also depend on purity, weight, design and workmanship.

For old-gold valuation, exchange and buy-back information, contact SM Gold directly so the purity and weight of the item can be assessed.
